before_binding.witness_note: Leaf n1289, printed p. 1289, running head `NOV. 15-ST. ALBERT THE GREAT`, under `Prayer` in the Mass headed `St. Albert the Great, Bishop, Confessor and Doctor of the Church`. The Latin is the 1962 slot's prayer, with the witness's retained-j orthography and abbreviated conclusion. The page itself prints Albert's name, title and English.

translations.text: O God, who to subject human wisdom to divine faith hast made great Thy Bishop and Doctor blessed Albert, grant us, we beseech Thee, so to follow in the path of his teaching as to enjoy perfect light in heaven. Through our Lord.
